rawFindings.title: Incorrect fallback in preprocessor chain causes file content read twice
rawFindings.explanation: In the updated createPreprocessor function, the SHA computation preprocessor was moved after the check that triggers fs.readFile and nextPreprocessor invocation only if preprocessors.length > 0. Because preprocessors array is empty initially, the new code always adds the SHA computation preprocessor, then immediately always reads the file and executes preprocessors. This changes behavior from the previous logic that would do nothing if no preprocessor matched (skip reading file). This might caus
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the logic to only invoke fs.readFile and processing chain if there are preprocessors (including SHA). Alternatively, always add the SHA computation preprocessor first so that 'preprocessors.length' is never zero during the condition check.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: When config.preprocessors is empty, the preprocessor function will still read the file and compute SHA, causing extra file read and setting file.sha unexpectedly. Previously it would do nothing and call done immediately.
